section.37: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed]

37.name_native: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed]

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Abu Bakrah said:"The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: 'If a Muslim points a weapon at his fellow Muslim, then they are on the brink of Hell, and if he kills him, then they will both fall into it
